    *   Yellow: mBERT-L2

    The Semitic language family consistently shows the highest effect values across all model configurations. The mBERT-R2 model achieves the highest effect value within the Semitic family.

    For the Semitic language family, all six model configurations show a negative effect value.

    The IE-Slavic language family has the smallest spread across its six model configurations. The effect values are clustered relatively closely together.

    The IE-Celtic language family shows the highest effect value with the XLM-L2 model configuration.  The IE-Baltic language family shows a lower effect value, with the mBERT-L2 model configuration having the highest value.
